newsitem.title: GREECE: Alpha Credit Bank signs $150mln loan facility - Sanwa.
newsitem.headline: Alpha Credit Bank signs $150mln loan facility - Sanwa.

text.p: Alpha Credit Bank, London branch signed a $150 million multi-currency term loan facility, arranger Sanwa Bank said in a statement.
"The transaction was healthily oversubscribed in syndication, with $180 million being raised in syndication," the Sanwa Bank said. "Twenty-three banks from 12 countries joined the syndication."
The margin was 0.125 percent over Libor, it added.
The arrangers of the transaction are the Dai-Ichi-Kangyo Bank, Deutsche Bank, Dresdner Bank Luxembourg and the Sanwa Bank, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
